onboarding.lang.title: Support that reaches you
onboarding.lang.sub: Choose the language you would like to hear and read.
onboarding.connect.title: Connect your services
onboarding.connect.sub: Linking your Farmer ID fills in your village, land and crop, and shows which schemes you are already enrolled in — so you type nothing.
onboarding.connect.privacy: We never ask for or store your Aadhaar, bank account or lender details. Only a token and coarse farm details are shared.
onboarding.farm.title: Your farm
onboarding.farm.subLinked: Filled in from your Farmer ID — change anything that looks wrong.
onboarding.farm.subManual: Tap the pictures that match your field.
onboarding.farm.irrigation: How do you water the field?
onboarding.support.title: Support you already have
onboarding.support.sub: This helps us judge how exposed your field is. It never affects any entitlement you hold.
onboarding.support.dueTitle: Warn me before a repayment month
onboarding.support.dueBody: Timing only — a rough week and amount band. Never an account, lender or credit record.
onboarding.support.note: Your status is a support signal, not a credit, loan-default or insurance score.
onboarding.privacy.title: What we may use
onboarding.privacy.sub: These start switched off. You can change any of them later, and delete everything at any time.
onboarding.privacy.storageBody: Needed to show your status again.
onboarding.privacy.contactBody: Lets an extension officer call or refer your case.
onboarding.privacy.emailBody: Also send urgent alerts to your email. Optional.
onboarding.privacy.analyticsBody: Only village-level group results are used.
onboarding.privacy.required: Saving your information is required to show a status.
